mostWorthwhile.text: The receiving laboratory scene was most worthwhile: another person seeing the folded limbs gives the discovery a quiet sense of consequence.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was no gameplay action in this chapter to evaluate. The ending is brief, though its silence suits the moment.

surprise.text: The shift from the station seen in orbit to the receiving laboratory was striking; the discovery has reached other people.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary in this chapter because there were no actions to choose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to learn what the receiving team makes of the body and its surrounding ice.
